elements_selected.content: Create src/web/chain.rs with helper functions to extract prev/next chain targets from frontmatter. extract_chain_target reads fm[field] as string, strips [[ ]] delimiters if present, strips alias text after pipe, strips heading refs after #, trims whitespace. Handles plain strings, wikilink syntax, aliased links, and heading refs. Also add resolve_page_name for case-insensitive slug lookup against page_slug_map. REQ-015-004, CON-015-001.
